why: Repairs pipeline-guard on main, broken by this lane: two PI-20260929-AQRK6CL1-0014 update records appended from different bases both merged (#14615, #14638), so `pipeline.py --check` exits 1 on a NEW collision. Append-only history cannot be rewritten, so (1) a record-scoped GRANDFATHERED_COLLISION_RECORDS names that ONE file (narrower than the id-level list, which would also hide future 0014 collisions; still reported loudly, never 'clean'), and (2) a new update record restores the displaced step-4 text verbatim. Tier-1 tooling + pipeline record; no runtime change.
